answer: Each new agent identity must burn a bond inside the same scarce resource the network meters: compute vouchers that decay unless renewed. Clones pile up liabilities that drain the operator every cycle while rewards stay capped per verified task, so a velvet cushion of honest capital is not shared with throwaway wallets. At dawn of each epoch the ledger sums unpaid bonds; sybils starve before they can hoard a single pearl of payout, and one tipped-off auditor reveals the whole cluster's shared funding trail. Cost to an attacker: the full bond per clone, unrecoverable.
